preconception.heroLead: We prepare carefully for the milestones that matter most in life. Pregnancy deserves that same thought, intention and preparation.
faqs: When should we start?
Ideally at least six months before you plan to conceive, and earlier where possible. That said, it is never too late to begin preparing.
Can my partner join?
Yes. The program is designed for couples, and both partners are encouraged to take part together.
How are sessions held?
6 live sessions of 60 minutes each, held online as live virtual sessions.
Does it guarantee conception?
No. The program does not promise conception, fertility outcomes or a particular pregnancy result. It helps you feel better prepared in body, mind and emotional wellbeing.
How does payment work?

There is no online payment on the website. After you enroll or request a call, our team will call you, answer your questions and share payment details on WhatsApp. You can pay by UPI or bank transfer to Amra Asha Education Trust, and your seat is confirmed once payment is received.
Do I need to pay right away?
No. Tap Enroll Now and share your details. We will call you first, and you pay only after your questions are answered and your batch is confirmed.
Does this replace medical care?
No. It complements care from your doctor, fertility specialist or other qualified healthcare professionals.
